issue_mapping.milestone: OC3-N33 Codegen Optimization And Direct Dispatch Policy

tokens: direct dispatch lowering remains unsupported on the live runtime path

allowed_moves: fold compile-time optional nil receiver sends to the typed zero result
preserve non-nil and unknown receivers on runtime dispatch paths
required_proofs: receiver facts mark compile_time_nil_receiver before elision
selector and argument materialization do not introduce runtime side effects for elided nil sends
positive fixtures cover unary and keyword optional nil sends
rejection_boundaries: do not fold shadowed nil identifiers
do not fold numeric zero receivers as object nil
do not bypass canonical runtime dispatch for unknown receivers

allowed_moves: lower concrete self sends and known class sends to exact direct-call symbols
coerce bool direct-call arguments through the existing i32-to-i1 marshalling helper
coerce direct-call results back through the existing typed value-to-i32 marshalling helper
required_proofs: callee symbol and signature are present in direct_dispatch_symbols_by_key and direct_dispatch_signatures_by_key
direct call request owns its result before IR emission
global proof state is invalidated after a direct dispatch call
rejection_boundaries: reject missing explicit IR result ownership
do not synthesize direct dispatch for dynamic, protocol, category, or unresolved receiver sites

allowed_moves: route super sends through from-class runtime dispatch using self as receiver and superclass as lookup start
route dynamic opt-out sends through canonical runtime dispatch
retain typed return kind marshalling for bool, void, object, class, selector, protocol, and i32 results
required_proofs: super receivers are normalized to known non-nil self receiver facts
runtime dispatch result owner remains explicit
selector pool and lookup-start class globals are present before IR call construction
rejection_boundaries: fail closed on non-canonical dispatch entrypoints
fail closed when runtime dispatch ownership is missing
never materialize selector-table, method-cache, or slow-path helper compatibility routes in IR lowering
